title: Change a Locked Rune and Start on a Variant

steps.intent: start a Claude Bare tab, send one short message, then open Runes and check the Lock button reads Locked
press Modify and switch one rune to State: Off; the notice offers Make Variant and Edit Original
press Make Variant and check the Runes view closes Modify, shows a notice that the change was saved as a new vault that new sessions can pick, and this tab keeps showing the original vault
start a new Claude tab, and in the Runes panel choose the new variant vault card and press Start Session
in the new tab's Runes view, check it shows the variant, the switched rune reads State: Off, and the first tab still shows the original vault
